sections.title: Open recall recovery
sections.sql: select recall,mode,owner,lot,product,destination,unit,distributed,unaccounted from recovery_balance where status='open' order by recall,lot,destination

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from record_checks order by recall,rule

sections.title: Lot balances
sections.sql: select * from lot_balance order by lot

sections.title: Distribution contacts
sections.sql: select * from distribution_contacts order by recall,lot,destination

sections.title: Unacknowledged
sections.sql: select recall,lot,destination,owner,response_due from recovery_balance where not acknowledged and status='open' order by response_due,recall
